thesis: The episode introduces Omer Cedar, CEO of Omega Point, who previously worked at Two Sigma on the Alpha Capture Program to combine fundamental investing with quantitative finance. Cedar argues that while quants dominated market volatility during the 2007-2009 period, they were a small component of market volume at the time, and the conversation explores how fundamental managers can better recognize factor risks and integrate quantitative insights into their strategies.
